metadata.subtitle: Fugue XIII in F-sharp major (a 4): Fuga canonica sopra il fondamento di Goldberg
metadata.composer: Claude / Sam (ground and folk songs after J. S. Bach, BWV 988)
metadata.tempo_text: Allegretto; Adagio in F-sharp minor; Quodlibet

markers.label: Intonazione: the subject in the bass
Canon III at the third (G# minor)
Canon IV at the fourth, by inversion (C#)
Return: Canon V at the fifth, by inversion (F#)
Canon VI at the sixth (F# minor, Adagio)

subject_entries.label: Subject (bass alone)
Canon I dux: subject
Canon I comes: subject at the unison
Tenor: subject inverted (on C#)
Canon II dux: subject on C#
Canon II comes: subject a second below, on B
Canon III dux: subject on B (mediant)
Canon III comes: subject a third below, on G#
Alto: subject on E# (C# major)
Canon IV dux: subject on C#
Canon IV comes: subject inverted, on G# (a fourth below)
Bass: subject on C# (retransition)
Canon V dux: subject on A# (the return)
Canon V comes: subject inverted, on D# (a fifth below)
Canon VI dux: subject on A (F-sharp minor)
Canon VI comes: subject a sixth above, on F#
Quodlibet: Kraut und Ruben, second phrase (the ground becomes the tune)
Quodlibet: Ich bin so lang nicht bei dir g'west
Ich bin so lang, canon at the octave above
Quodlibet: the subject over Ich bin
Quodlibet: Kraut und Ruben, first phrase
